finding.title: Delete the dead TrackOrder aggregate/OrderingLevel enum or fix its doc comment's false repository contract
finding.why: TrackOrder and OrderingLevel have zero references anywhere else in lib/ (grep confirms) — the actual TrackLearningOrderRepository interface returns bare List<LearningOrderItem> from getSedarimOrder/getMasechtosOrder, never a TrackOrder. But track_order.dart's own doc comment asserts '[TrackLearningOrderRepository] returns a [TrackOrder] from getSedarimOrder / getMasechtosOrder' — a confident, specific, and false description of the current contract. A future maintainer (e.g. picking up the W4.22 refactor referenced in masechta_ordering_policy.dart) who trusts this comment will build against an aggregate the real code never produces. Separately, TrackOrder hand-writes ==/hashCode/toString instead of using @freezed like every other domain model in this batch (StageDefinition, GoalEntity), and its hashCode only hashes items.length, so any two same-length differently-ordered TrackOrders collide.
finding.recommendation: Delete the file if the two-method-pair API is staying; if TrackOrder is genuinely planned to replace it, land that refactor (repository returns TrackOrder, callers updated) in the same change as the doc comment, and convert it to @freezed while doing so.
acceptance_criteria: Either track_order.dart is removed, or TrackLearningOrderRepository's methods actually return TrackOrder and the doc comment is true.
If kept, TrackOrder is a @freezed class with generated ==/hashCode, not hand-written ones.
`flutter analyze` and existing track_order tests stay green.

finding.title: Add a mounted guard after the awaited date-picker calls in SelfPacedGoalStep._pickDeadline
finding.why: Both branches of _pickDeadline call setState() straight after an awaited date-picker dialog with no `if (!mounted) return;` guard, unlike every other async-gap-then-setState in this same batch (step_starting_position.dart:89/114, step_starting_position_calendar.dart:97-98/100, step_scope.dart:150) which all check mounted first. If the user backs out of the Add-Track wizard while the date picker is open, the awaited Future resolves after State.dispose(), and setState() throws (framework error, not silently ignored) instead of the no-op the mounted guard would produce. This needs a runtime repro (rapid back-navigation during either date picker) to confirm it fires in practice, but the code path is unambiguous.
finding.recommendation: Add `if (!mounted) return;` immediately after each `await ...Picker.show/showLearningAppDatePicker(...)`, matching the guard style already used elsewhere in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: Both await sites in _pickDeadline check mounted before calling setState.
A widget test that disposes SelfPacedGoalStep while the picker Future is pending does not throw.

finding.title: Route TrackManagementBody's hard-delete ('wipe') path through a repository instead of calling trackDao directly (DB-1)
finding.why: _showDeleteDialog's 'wipe' branch pulls trackDao straight out of userDatabaseProvider and calls purgeHistory/deleteTrackAndData from a widget State, bypassing the repository layer DB-1 requires. It's an inconsistency within the same method: the sibling 'archive' branch a few lines above correctly goes through curriculumActivationServiceProvider and has typed try/catch + a localized error SnackBar; the 'wipe' branch has neither a repository nor any error handling at all — if either DAO call throws, the widget has no recovery path. (The DAO methods themselves are well-built — transactional, outbox-aware — so this is a layering/testability and inconsistent-error-handling defect, not a sync-correctness one.)
finding.recommendation: Add a track repository (or extend an existing one) with wipe/delete methods that widgets call, mirroring the 'archive' branch's service-layer pattern, including a try/catch with a localized error SnackBar for parity with the archive path.
acceptance_criteria: track_management_body.dart no longer reads userDatabaseProvider or trackDao directly.
The 'wipe' branch has the same try/catch + user-facing error handling as the 'archive' branch.
DB-1's checker (once implemented) reports zero direct DAO access from lib/features/*/presentation/.

finding.title: Split scope_views.dart, step_goal.dart, step_scope.dart, step_starting_position_calendar.dart, and stage_definition_repository_impl.dart under AG-3's 400-line cap
finding.why: scope_views.dart (487 lines), step_goal.dart (487), step_scope.dart (448), step_starting_position_calendar.dart (468), and stage_definition_repository_impl.dart (474) all exceed the 400-line hand-written-file cap, making each harder to navigate/review as a single unit (scope_views.dart alone holds two large, independent view classes plus their breadcrumb builder; step_goal.dart mixes pace math, deadline math, and a large build()).
finding.recommendation: Extract scope_views.dart's ScopeHierarchyView + its _buildBreadcrumbs helper into its own file; extract step_goal.dart's pace/deadline card-building and derivation glue (already partly in goal_helpers.dart) further out of the State class; split stage_definition_repository_impl.dart's schedule encode/decode helpers into a small codec-adjacent file.
acceptance_criteria: AG-3's line-count checker (once implemented) reports zero violators in this batch.

finding.title: Consolidate the tracks/{setup,stages,track_order} test suite onto mirrored paths under test/features/tracks/** (AG-5)
finding.why: test/features/track_setup/**, test/features/stages/**, and test/features/track_learning_order/** all still exist and DO test current lib code (confirmed via their imports) — they are not stale — but none of them mirror the actual lib/features/tracks/{setup,stages,track_order}/** layout. A correctly-mirrored tree has also grown alongside them (e.g. test/features/tracks/setup/**, test/features/tracks/track_order/**), so coverage for this feature area is now split across two parallel, differently-named directory trees. A developer adding a new test for goal_helpers.dart would not find the existing one unless they already knew to look under the legacy 'track_setup' (singular, no 'tracks/' prefix) name instead of the mirrored 'tracks/setup' path, risking either an undiscovered duplicate or accidentally-orphaned old tests.
finding.recommendation: Move test/features/track_setup/**, test/features/stages/**, and test/features/track_learning_order/** to their AG-5-mirrored locations under test/features/tracks/{setup,stages,track_order}/**, merging with the already-correct parallel tree where both exist for the same source file.
acceptance_criteria: AG-5's mirroring checker (once implemented) reports zero unmirrored test directories for tracks/setup, tracks/stages, and tracks/track_order.
No test file is lost or silently duplicated during the move (`flutter test` count before == after).
